fields.label: Apply Strict User Permissions
fields.description: If Apply Strict User Permission is checked and User Permission is defined for a DocType for a User, then all the documents where value of the link is blank, will not be shown to that User

fields.label: Session Expiry (idle timeout)
fields.description: Example: Setting this to 24:00 will log out a user if they are not active for 24:00 hours.

fields.label: Document Share Key Expiry (in Days)
fields.description: Number of days after which the document Web View link shared on email will be expired

fields.label: Allow only one session per user
Disable Username/Password Login
fields.description: Make sure to configure a Social Login Key before disabling to prevent lockout

fields.label: Allow Login using Mobile Number
fields.description: User can login using Email id or Mobile number

fields.label: Allow Login using User Name
fields.description: User can login using Email id or User Name

fields.label: Login with email link
fields.description: Allow users to log in without a password, using a login link sent to their email

fields.label: Login with email link expiry (in minutes)
Rate limit for email link login
fields.description: You can set a high value here if multiple users will be logging in from the same network.

fields.label: Allow Login After Fail
fields.description: In seconds

fields.label: Bypass Two Factor Auth for users who login from restricted IP Address
fields.description: If enabled, users who login from Restricted IP Address, won't be prompted for Two Factor Auth

fields.label: Bypass restricted IP Address check If Two Factor Auth Enabled
fields.description: If enabled, all users can login from any IP Address using Two Factor Auth. This can also be set only for specific user(s) in User Page

fields.label: Two Factor Authentication method
fields.description: Choose authentication method to be used by all users

fields.label: Expiry time of QR Code Image Page
fields.description: Time in seconds to retain QR code image on server. Min:240

fields.label: OTP SMS Template
fields.description: OTP placeholder should be defined as {{ otp }}

fields.label: Logout All Sessions on Password Reset
Force User to Reset Password
fields.description: In Days

fields.label: Password Reset Link Generation Limit
fields.description: Hourly rate limit for generating password reset links

fields.label: Enable Password Policy
fields.description: If enabled, the password strength will be enforced based on the Minimum Password Score value. A value of 1 being very weak and 4 being very strong.

fields.label: Minimum Password Score
fields.description:
0 - too guessable: risky password.
1 - very guessable: protection from throttled online attacks.
2 - somewhat guessable: protection from unthrottled online attacks.
3 - safely unguessable: moderate protection from offline slow-hash scenario.
4 - very unguessable: strong protection from offline slow-hash scenario.

fields.label: Email Footer Address
fields.description: Your organization name and address for the email footer.

fields.label: Hide footer in auto email reports
Include Web View Link in Email
Store Attached PDF Document
fields.description: When sending document using email, store the PDF on Communication. Warning: This can increase your storage usage.

fields.label: Max Zip Extract Size (MB)
fields.description: Maximum total size a ZIP archive is allowed to expand to when extracted.

fields.label: Allow Guests to Upload Files
fields.description: When enabled this will allow guests to upload files to your application, You can enable this if you wish to collect files from user without having them to log in, for example in job applications web form.

fields.label: Force Web Capture Mode for Uploads
fields.description: When uploading files, force the use of the web-based image capture. If this is unchecked, the default behavior is to use the mobile native camera when use from a mobile is detected.

fields.label: Strip EXIF tags from uploaded images
Only allow System Managers to upload public files
fields.description: If enabled, only System Managers can upload public files. Other users can't see the checkbox Is Private in the upload dialog.

fields.label: Delete Background Exported Reports After (Hours)
fields.description: Defines how long exported reports sent via email are kept in the system. Older files will be automatically deleted.

fields.label: Allowed File Extensions
fields.description:
Provide a list of allowed file extensions for file uploads. Each line should contain one allowed file type. If unset, all file extensions are allowed. Example:
CSV
JPG
PNG

fields.label: Allowed Doctypes for Guest Uploads
fields.description:
Provide a list of allowed Doctypes for file uploads. Each line should contain one allowed Doctype. If unset, uploads to all doctypes are allowed. Example:
User
Item
Quotation

fields.label: Default App
fields.description: Redirect to the selected app after login

fields.label: Number of Backups
fields.description: Older backups will be automatically deleted

fields.label: Max auto email report per user
Max Report Rows
fields.description: This value specifies the max number of rows that can be rendered in report view.

fields.label: Enable Scheduled Jobs
fields.description: Run scheduled jobs only if checked

fields.label: Run Jobs only Daily if Inactive For (Days)
fields.description: Will run scheduled jobs only once a day for inactive sites. Set it to 0 to avoid automatically disabling the scheduler.

fields.label: Show Full Error and Allow Reporting of Issues to the Developer
Allow Sending Usage Data for Improving Applications
Allow Clearing Link Fields
fields.description: Adds a clear (×) button to Link fields, allowing users to quickly remove the selected value.
